newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL -- ITT seen moving lower.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL -- ITT seen moving lower.

text.p: Shares in ITT Corp are expected to trade sharply lower at Tuesday's U.S. market open, with the stock bid at 53 before the open, three points under yesterday's New York Stock Exchange close.

Traders said the shares are under pressure from ITT's announcement Monday after the market close that third quarter results will be below expectations because of a decline in August revenue at its premium gaming business.
Further, ITT said it does not expect the period's gaming shortfalls to be offset by improved fourth quarter performance.
The third quarter gaming weakness was primarily in ITT's Las Vegas operations, and will lead to earnings that are likely to be near year-ago levels of $0.56 a share, it said.
"ITT is going to trade lower on the pre-announced negative earnings surprise. The stock closed in New York at 56 and is bid at 53 and offered as low as 49," a trader said.
Further repelling inverstors, he said, was a downgrade of ITT by Bear Stearns to attractive from buy.
Another market source said Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette also downgraded ITT this morning, to outperfrom from buy.
Also, a Smith Barney source said the firm too downgraded ITT, to neutral from buy.
Iomega Corp traded higher after it announced this morning a non-exclusive licensing agreement with Matsushita Communication Industrial Co Ltd.
Under the agreement, Matsushita will produce Zip computer memory drives and sell them under Matsushita's brand names as well as to original equipment manufacturers.
Iomega rose to 14-3/8 from 13-5/16 preceding the open.
